subject.title: [Feature]: Agents page selector should be a themed HTML dropdown showing agent avatars

question: Should the Agents page keep the compact picker and upgrade it to an avatar-aware themed dropdown, or should this be folded into the broader visible-list/sidebar redesign?
rationale: Current main still uses the native select, the broader visible-list issue remains open, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not choose the permanent Agents navigation pattern.

options.title: Adopt avatar dropdown
options.body: Build the custom themed listbox as a bounded incremental Control UI improvement while preserving the existing toolbar layout and selection contract.

options.title: Fold into visible-list redesign
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57067 as the canonical direction and solve agent identity visibility through a desktop list/sidebar instead of a richer dropdown.

options.title: Keep native select
options.body: Close or defer this request after documenting that the native select is the intended Agents page picker for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt avatar dropdown
recommendation.body: Build the custom themed listbox as a bounded incremental Control UI improvement while preserving the existing toolbar layout and selection contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is a detailed product-direction request from steipete and his history includes adjacent Agents view refactoring.
